data.name: Gyanaranjan
data.gender_notes: Gyanaranjan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gyan (knowledge) and Ranj (adorned). Derived from the Sanskrit words gyanam (knowledge) and ranjana (adorned). This name evokes images of wisdom, learning, and spiritual growth. The name Gyanaranjan carries the meaning “Knowledge adorned” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gyanaranjan usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge adorned and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be filled with knowledge and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Gyanaranjan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge adorned.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gyanaranjan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Gyanaranjan reflects the cultural and spiritual values of the Sanskrit tradition and is used in Hindu communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gyanaranjan represents the inner journey towards knowledge and spiritual growth. The pursuit of wisdom and understanding is seen as a means to achieve a greater connection with the divine, ultimately leading to the realization of one's true self. The word "Ranj" implies a sense of inner adornment, suggesting that as one gains knowledge and wisdom, they also develop an inner beauty and grace that shines from within. This name serves as a constant reminder to always strive for knowledge and wisdom, while also recognizing and celebrating the spiritual growth and inner beauty that comes with it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Gyanaranjan signifies the one who is adorned with wisdom and knowledge. It reflects the pursuit and attainment of spiritual enlightenment through intellectual growth.
